macOS desktop build — Tauri (Rust backend) + the NoMoreIDE React UI.

**This build is unsigned.** On first launch macOS will block it. To open:
1. Drag NoMoreIDE into Applications and double-click it.
2. Open System Settings → Privacy & Security.
3. Under Security, click "Open Anyway" next to the NoMoreIDE message.
4. Confirm with Touch ID / password.
